title: What Is a Pathway?
description: A pathway is a route of powers, rituals, and escalating risks.

title: The Door Sequence
description: The Door pathway rewards preparation, distance, and impossible exits.

title: The *quiet* between stars
description: Concealment is not absence; it is control of what can be perceived.

title: Misdirection
does: Redirect attention until a false route feels inevitable.
doesNot: Erase every consequence or replace careful planning.
edgeText: A sharp observer still finds the seam.

name: The Hanged Man
description: The Club sees a quiet scholar with dangerous patience.
detailText: A shepherd who knows what the shadows conceal.
footerText: The truth has more than one face.

name: Edwina
evidence: Reader Pathway potential, good chemistry with Gehrman, and the fandom still asking where the rest of her story went.
counterpoint: Not every strong side character needed a Tarot Club seat.

ritual: Drink the potion while a mermaid sings.
survival: The potion tightens the aspirant’s Spirit Body Threads. The song keeps emotion and selfhood from going rigid.
preparation: Marionettist means taking hold of another person’s threads without confusing their body with your own.
uncertainty: The emotional counter-resonance is an interpretation, not a named rule.
footerText: Learn the strings. Keep your name.

ritual: Prepare four special coordinates deep in the Spirit World, far apart.
survival: The potion throws the aspirant through the Spirit World. The coordinates give direction, memory, and a route home.
preparation: Traveler is Position under pressure: mark places, keep a link to them, and return before distance becomes disorientation.
uncertainty: Canon shows the coordinates helping navigation, but does not explain their deeper geometry.
footerText: Every journey needs a way back.

title: Who owns the Fool?
text: Pre-Epoch to Book Two, in eleven turning points.

title: Flegrea
text: Fool authority already circulates inside a court of Ancient Gods.
note: The connection is certain. The exact Fool assets are not.

title: Sequence 0
text: Three characteristics, one Uniqueness and Sefirah Castle: Half-Lord of Mysteries.

title: Three movements
moves: The Celestial Worthy holds the group, and Sefirah Castle holds him.
The pathway fragments between Flegrea, Antigonus and the angelic families.
Klein reunites the Uniqueness and ascends to Half-Lord of Mysteries.
footerText: Three states worth keeping apart: Sequence 0 Fool, Half-Lord of Mysteries, and a will that never died.
